description: Search the hotels in The Edit by Chase Travel (the Chase Sapphire Reserve luxury hotel collection) with their typical Chase Travel nightly rate and whether they take the 2026 double credit. Returns at most 20 per page and 5 pages.

brand.description: Brand or hotel family, e.g. Four Seasons, Kimpton, Ritz-Carlton

city.description: City name, e.g. Paris (NYC and DC work)

country.description: Country name or 2-letter code (USA and UK work)

double_credit.description: Only hotels where the Edit and select-hotel credits stack (bookings made by Dec 31, 2026)

max_nightly_usd.description: Only hotels with a typical nightly rate at or below this

query.description: Free text: every word must match the hotel name, city, state, country or brand, e.g. "four seasons chicago"

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code, e.g. California or CA

name: search_edit_hotels
title: Search Edit by Chase hotels
